question: Can independent bounded six-leg placement recover contact-only root balance?
hypothesis: A fixed nine-target IK grid plus unchanged neutral control improves on common-offset hind-only contacts without model/force changes.
units: Native MuJoCo model units, exactly as the existing source study; not animal measurements
controls: unchanged neutral initial pose on the same unanchored-root variant
analytic symmetric support and unsupported hind-only toy models
original nine-pose A/B evidence preserved unchanged
success_criterion: One foot-only root-balanced initial placement; full muscle static feasibility is a distinct further gate, never standing/walking.
falsification: No root-balanced placement in this exact grid rejects this bounded hypothesis, not all poses or the overall organism goal. Solver budget exhaustion is inconclusive.

parameters.selection: root feasible first, then most distinct feet, then shallowest depth
parameters.targets: neutral terminal tarsus5 body origins; scaled XY around root; min neutral Z plus offset
parameters.full_support: one selected root-feasible depth per candidate, original solver/force bounds
